name: e5-platform
description: Spec-driven development harness for the E5 platform. Loads the platform overview at session start and navigates the knowledge base by path and exact name - no keyword search. User commands: /e5-init, /e5-sync, /e5-feature and /e5-bugfix (gated: UX + HLD or root cause, blast radius, LLD, then code), /e5-update-knowledge-base.
